courses.title: Courses
courses.emptyHint: Create a course manually or generate one from materials

courseBuilder.title: Course builder
courseBuilder.description: Describe a topic or practice in your own words — the AI writes the notes, splits them into knowledge atoms and builds a course with lessons and practice. Or upload your materials (pdf, docx, txt, md).

stageHint.EXTRACTING: Extracting text from materials or writing notes for the topic, splitting into atoms
stageHint.OUTLINING: The AI extracts knowledge nodes citing atoms; citations are verified by code
stageHint.GENERATING: Writing lessons per module: theory, quiz, gaps, practice
stageHint.READY: Draft is ready — review and accept to create the course
stageHint.FAILED: Failed — try refining the topic or uploading another file

form.modeTopicHint: No notes: describe the topic, lesson plan or practice — the AI writes the notes itself.
form.modeMaterialsHint: Upload notes, a handbook or slides — text is extracted automatically.
form.filesHint: pdf, docx, txt, md — up to 50 MB each
form.topicHint: At least {{min}} characters. E.g. "for and while loops in Python, list practice, grade 7, 2 lessons"
